answer: Proof-of-Personhood Beacon Quill. New agents lock 100 POA as a sybil bond and register a device fingerprint on the beacon chain. A rotating quill committee of 50 peers signs each identity once per epoch—no re-issue, no duplicates. A sybil farm needs 100 POA per fake identity plus one server per node, so 1000 fake agents cost 100,000 POA and hardware. Like minting one gold coin per ghost: the tide of spam recedes when every voice carries a price tag.
